title: Players | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Players
hero.lead: The Players area in Kaderblick combines master data with time-limited club and team assignments. Visible and editable players depend on your roles and relationships with the club, team or player.

body:
Player overview

  • Season: determines which time-matching team assignments appear.
  • Filter by team: limits the list. With “All teams”, several assignments can appear per player.
  • Search players: automatically filters by name after input.
  • Club, teams and nationalities: show stored assignments. Team details may include shirt number, age group and assignment type.
  • Arrow beside teams: expands older or additional assignments.
  • Bookmark: adds or removes the player from your watchlist.
  • Info: opens details. Pencil edits and bin opens deletion confirmation if permitted.
  • Items per page and arrows: control page size and results pages.

Assign an existing player or create a new one

  1. 1
    Open the dialog
    Select New player.
  2. 2
    Search existing records
    Enter at least two name characters under Search player. If the person exists, select them and add only the new assignment.
  3. 3
    Record a new player
    If no result matches, select Create new player and complete the master data.
  4. 4
    Add memberships
    Add at least the club or team assignment required for your work area.
  5. 5
    Save
    Check required fields and assignment periods, then select Save.

Master data and positions

  • First and last name: required for clear display.
  • Date of birth and email: optional personal details.
  • Strong foot: required choice of left, right or both.
  • Main position: required preferred position.
  • Alternative positions: other usable positions, including for line-up planning.
  • Nationalities: one or more. Authorised people can create a missing nationality from the picker.

Club and team assignments

Master data alone does not place a person in a squad. Memberships do:

  • Club assignment: club, start date and optional end date.
  • Team assignment: team, assignment type, shirt number, start date and optional end date.
  • Empty end date: the assignment continues.
  • Several assignments: represent transfers, previous seasons or parallel squads. Do not create another player record.

A greyed item is read-only for you: you may see the person without being allowed to manage that particular assignment.

Player details

Details show date of birth, teams with shirt number, assignment type and period, nationalities and licences. With permission, Edit and Delete are available. Share highlight can generate the intended player graphic.

Connections to other areas

  • Line-ups use the active squad and recorded positions.
  • Matches, matchday and reports use players and team assignments.
  • A player relationship controls personal access; a team or club role can grant access to a wider squad.

Merge duplicate players

Kaderblick groups accessible player profiles with the same normalised name. The dialog shows their team, club, profile details, linked match data and relations.

  1. Inspect every candidate using the information icon.
  2. Select at least two profiles for merging and mark the retained main player.
  3. Safe deletion is enabled only when Kaderblick has found no protected links; otherwise merge the profile.
  4. Apply the selection. Conflicting profile values open a second review first.

Resolve conflicting player data

Supported assignments are transferred to the main player and overlaps are not created twice. Review carefully because this permanently changes the involved profiles.
